The Role Day-to-day at Ekco: As an L1 NOC Engineer, you will be the first line of response for monitoring alerts, incidents and service requests. You will carry out initial triage and basic troubleshooting, maintain accurate service tickets and keep customers informed with clear, timely updates. Working within agreed processes and runbooks, you will resolve known issues and escalate to L2 when further expertise, access or authority is needed. Identify major incidents and escalate to key stakeholders. Log incidents clearly with accurate details, timestamps, affected services and initial observations. Initial Troubleshooting Perform standard first-line checks using agreed runbooks and troubleshooting guides. Check device availability, interface status, circuit status, monitoring alerts, recent changes and known issues. Carry out basic diagnostics where permitted, including ping, traceroute, monitoring review, log review and standard service checks. Resolve known and repeatable issues within agreed permissions. Communication and Ownership Provide clear and timely ticket updates. Ensure ticket notes are understandable, factual and useful for the next engineer. Escalate to L2 when an issue exceeds L1 capability, access, authority or defined troubleshooting steps. Follow handover processes at shift change or when transferring ownership. Customer focused. Process Compliance Follow incident, request, escalation, change and communication processes. Use correct ticket categories, priorities, templates and closure notes. Ensure tickets are not closed without appropriate validation. Capture recurring issues or documentation gaps and feed them back to L2, Platform Engineering or the Alignment Engineer. What Good Looks Like Alerts are picked up quickly and triaged correctly. Tickets contain clear, accurate and useful information. Known issues are resolved consistently. Comfortable multitasking while working under pressure Escalations are made at the right time with the right detail. Handover is clean and does not cause repeated investigation. Key Requirements Ability to monitor alerts and service queues, assess impact and urgency, and prioritise tickets accurately. Understanding of basic network and service troubleshooting, including device, interface and circuit checks, ping, traceroute and log review. Ability to follow runbooks and agreed processes, resolve standard issues within permitted access and recognise when to escalate to L2. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document incidents, troubleshooting evidence and next steps clearly and accurately. A customer-focused approach, with a commitment to providing clear, timely updates and taking ownership of ticket handling. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to multitask and remain focused under pressure. Ability to provide clear shift handovers and work collaboratively with other engineers. A process-focused approach to ticket validation and closure, with a willingness to flag recurring issues and documentation gaps. Vous interviendrez principalement sur le support de niveau 3 des environnements Elastic Stack, avec un rôle d’expertise dans l’analyse des incidents, le diagnostic des dysfonctionnements, l’analyse des performances et l’amélioration continue des dispositifs de supervision et d’exploitation. Identifier les anomalies de traitement, problèmes d’indexation, pertes de données ou dégradations de performances. Apporter un support technique aux équipes d’exploitation lors d’incidents majeurs ou complexes. Participer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de diagnostic et de résolution d’incidents. Formaliser les procédures de diagnostic et de résolution des incidents récurrents. Contribuer à la capitalisation et au partage des bonnes pratiques techniques. Transfert de compétences Assurer le transfert de compétences auprès des équipes internes. Accompagner les équipes dans leur montée en compétence sur Elastic Stack et les méthodes de diagnostic. Garantir la traçabilité des actions réalisées sur les plateformes. Veiller à la qualité de la documentation et des procédures d’exploitation. Contribuer à la fiabilité, à la disponibilité et à la maintenabilité des infrastructures. Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques d’exploitation et de support. Très bonne maîtrise d’Elastic Stack, notamment Elasticsearch, Logstash et Kibana. Expérience significative en support N3, analyse d’incidents et troubleshooting. Bonne capacité d’analyse des logs, des performances et des flux de données. Capacité à intervenir dans des environnements techniques complexes et sensibles. Rigueur, autonomie, capacité d’analyse et sens du service. Bon relationnel et capacité à transmettre ses connaissances à des équipes techniques. Compétences techniques Systèmes : Linux / Red Hat / RHEL. Elastic Stack : Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana. Exploitation : support N3, troubleshooting, analyse d’incidents, MCO/MCS. Observabilité : logs, supervision, analyse des performances, flux de données. Documentation : procédures d’exploitation, fiches réflexes, documentation technique. Une connaissance des environnements Ansible, Git, VMware ou outils de supervision constitue un plus.
